questions.q: You have prices = [10, 20, 30]. You want [11.0, 22.0, 33.0] (each price plus 10%). Which code works?
options: [p for p in prices if p * 1.1]
why: Correct. The comprehension changes every value. (Floating point may show 11.000000000000002.)
This filters the values. It does not change them.
You cannot multiply a list by a decimal. This raises an error.

questions.q: You want the number of days with more than 5000 steps. steps = [4200, 5100, 3900, 6000]. Which code works?
options: len([s for s in steps if s > 5000])
why: Correct. Filter first, then count the result.
